name: describe_card_type
title: Explain a card type
description:
Explains up to 8 card types (`keys`): what each is for, the common mistake, its settings, a complete
working `example`, its outcomes and the variables it writes. `outcomes` is the set before a card's own
settings: `classify_intent` also has one per intent and `conditional` one per branch. `blocking`: the
flow waits for the next inbound message, which can depend on settings. `waits_for_customer`: a run can
sit on it. `provides_variables` is offered, not promised; `collect_fields` names its own. `legacy`: no
longer addable. `list_card_types` lists the keys.

keys.description: Up to 8 card type keys, for example ["collect_fields", "send_message"].
